Explain in a short self-contained paragraph why a bicycle tyre feels softer on a cold morning, without numbers. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: Cold air makes the gas molecules inside a tyre move more slowly, so they strike the inner walls with less force. That lowers the pressure, and with less pressure pushing outward, the tyre squashes more under your weight and feels softer.
